steps_hi: बोर्ड पर 52 और 28 लिखें। 52 के लिए 5 बंडल (हर बंडल 10) और 2 अलग तिलियाँ रखें।
पूछें: 8 तिलियाँ कैसे निकालें जब सिर्फ 2 हैं?
पूछें: एक बंडल खोलें: अब 4 बंडल और 12 तिलियाँ। 10 + 2 = 12। यही उधार है।
अब 12 में से 8 निकालें → 4 बचीं। 4 बंडल − 2 बंडल = 2 बंडल यानी 20। उत्तर 24।
हर बच्चा 63 − 27 ऐसे ही तिलियों से करे।
47 − 23 बोर्ड पर लिखें। 4 दहाई, 7 इकाई।
उत्तर 24। दहाई-इकाई को साफ लिखकर दिखाएँ।
बच्चे 3 और सवाल अपनी कॉपी में करें।

activities.title_hi: बंडल जोड़ो: बिना हासिल का जोड़
steps_hi: बच्चे तिलियों से 4 सवाल करें और अपनी कॉपी में लिखें।
इकाई: 8 + 5 = 13। पूछें: 13 में से 10 लेकर एक बंडल बनाओ।
पूछें: अब कितनी दहाई हैं? 2 + 1 + 1 = 4। कितनी इकाई? 3। उत्तर 43।
बच्चे 3 सवाल इसी तरह करें।
3 + 4 से शुरू करें। पहले 3 अंगुली उठाओ, फिर 4 और।
बिना अंगुली के भी बताइए कितना होगा।
5 तिलियाँ रखें। 2 हटाओ। कितनी बचीं?
4 सवाल बच्चे खुद करें।
10 तीलियों का एक बंडल बनाओ: यह एक दहाई है।
अध्यापक एक संख्या बोलें (जैसे 34); बच्चे 3 बंडल और 4 खुली तीलियाँ रखें।
हर बच्चा बोले: '3 दहाई, 4 इकाई = 34'।
उल्टा करें: बच्चे बंडल दिखाएँ, बाकी संख्या बताएँ।

reassessment.ask_hi: 56 में कितनी दहाई और इकाई हैं?

steps_hi: 2 का पहाड़ा साथ में गाएँ।
बीच में रुककर पूछें: 2 × 6?
3 और 4 का पहाड़ा दोहराएँ।
4 सवाल बिना पहाड़ा गाए बताइए।
बोर्ड पर क, ख, ग, घ लिखें।
एक बच्चे से कहें: 'ग' छुओ।
5 अक्षर और दोहराएँ।
पहले 3 अक्षर मिलाएँ। किसमें फर्क है?

reassessment.ask_hi: ग की आवाज़ बोलो। कौन सा अक्षर?

steps_hi: बिना मात्रा: क। आ की मात्रा लगाओ: का।
मात्रा पहचानो: क में खड़ी लकीर जोड़ने पर का।
इ की मात्रा: कि (पहले), ई की: की (बाद में)।
4 शब्द बच्चे पढ़ें: का, गा, कि, की।
क + म + ल → कमल। धीरे-धीरे जोड़ें।
बच्चे साथ पढ़ें, फिर अकेले।
घर, कल, मल जैसे शब्द दोहराएँ।
जो फंसे उन्हें अलग बुलाकर अक्षर दोहराएँ।

reassessment.ask_hi: क, ल, म से शब्द बनाओ

steps_hi: हर बच्चे को 15 बीज दें।
गिनकर रखें, फिर 5 और दें: कुल कितने?
खाली हाथ 1 से 20 तक गिनें।
किसी बच्चे से 10 के बाद 20 तक बोलने को कहें।
62 − 45 लिखें। एक बच्चा 5 में से 2 करने की गलती करे।
पूछें: क्या 45, 62 से बड़ा है? नहीं। तो उधार चाहिए।
साफ बताएँ: ऊपर वाला कम हो तो उधार लो।
दो उदाहरण ऐसे ही बोर्ड पर करें।
बटन से 3 थाली, हर थाली में 4 रखें।
पहले जोड़कर देखें, फिर उत्तर लिखें 12।
बोर्ड पर 4 वाक्य लिखें।
हर बच्चा 1 वाक्य पढ़े, बाकी सुनें।
कहाँ ठहरते हैं वहाँ धीरे-धीरे पढ़ने को कहें।
दूसरी बार पढ़ाएँ और गति सुधरने पर ध्यान दें।
activities.blackboard_hi: राम का घर। सीता का कलम।

steps_hi: कि / की / कु / कू लिखकर पढ़वाएँ।
पूछें: कि में छोटी मात्रा कहाँ?
कि-की, कु-कू के जोड़े से पहचान बनाएँ।
5 मात्रा वाले शब्द पढ़वाएँ।
क-म-ल दिखाएँ।
बीच में आ की मात्रा लगाओ → कामल? नहीं।
सही: कमल बिना मात्रा, काम आ के साथ।
बच्चे 3 शब्द बनाएँ: का, कमल, कल।
बच्चे साथ पढ़ें: दो सौ छत्तीस…
फिर अध्यापक बोलें, बच्चे लिखें।
शून्य के स्थान पर सवाल: 305 में 0 कहाँ है?

activities.materials_hi: Chalk and board; 8 paper slips with letters (a, b, d, p, m, s, t, o); slates or notebooks
steps_hi: Write b, d, p, q on the board. Say each name slowly and ask the children to say it after you.
Teach a clue for b: draw the straight line first, then the round part on the right, like a bat and a ball. For d, draw the round part first, then the line.
Call out a letter. The children point to it on the board; a few come up and touch it.
Show a slip. A child says the letter name and writes the capital and the small letter on the slate.
activities.blackboard_hi: b  d  p  q      A a    B b

reassessment.ask_hi: Show b and d. Ask: Which one is 'd'?

activities.materials_hi: Things on the desk: pen, book, bag, cup
steps_hi: Hold up a pen. Say: pen. The first sound is p, a short 'puh'. It is not 'pee'.
Do the same with book (b), bag (b) and cup (c says 'kuh'). The children say the first sound together.
Say a word: sun, map, ten, hat. The children say only the first sound.
The children look around the room. Each child finds one thing, says its name and its first sound.
activities.blackboard_hi: p - pen    b - bag    s - sun

reassessment.ask_hi: What is the first sound in 'sun'?

activities.materials_hi: Things in the room: pen, book, bag, slate; the children's own body and clothes
steps_hi: Touch your head and say: head. The children touch their heads and say: head. Repeat with eyes, nose, hand and leg.
Hold up a pen, a book and a bag. Say each name; the children repeat it twice.
Point to something red, then blue, then green. Ask: What colour is it?
In pairs, one child points to a thing and the other says its English name. Then they swap.
activities.blackboard_hi:
head   eye   nose   hand
red   blue   green

reassessment.ask_hi: Point to a book and ask: What is this?

activities.title_hi: Say the sounds, then the word
activities.materials_hi: 5–6 small stones or bottle caps for each group; chalk
steps_hi: Put three stones on the floor for c-a-t. Touch each stone and say its sound: c, a, t.
Slide your finger under the three stones and say the word fast: cat. The children copy you.
Do the same with p-i-g, s-u-n and h-e-n. The children touch the stones, then say the word.
Write cat on the board. The children read it by saying each sound, then the whole word. Do not let them guess from the first letter.
Change one sound: cat, cap, cup. Ask: Which sound changed?
activities.blackboard_hi: c - a - t = cat      p - i - g = pig

reassessment.ask_hi: Join the sounds: h-e-n. What is the word?

activities.title_hi: Build a sentence with word cards
activities.materials_hi: 8–10 paper slips, one word on each (I, see, a, cat, the, is, my, and)
steps_hi: Show the slips one at a time: I, see, a, the, is, my. The children read each word. Say tricky words together; do not sound them out.
Lay out I, see, a, cat. Slide your finger under the words and read: I see a cat.
Mix the slips. A child puts them back in order and reads the sentence, moving a finger smoothly under the words.
Swap one word: I see a dog. Ask: Which word changed? Each pair makes one new sentence with the slips and reads it to the class.
activities.blackboard_hi:
I see a cat.    The cat is big.
the   is   my   and   to

reassessment.ask_hi: Read this sentence: The sun is hot.

activities.materials_hi: Chalk and board; slate or notebook for each child
steps_hi: Write sh, ch, th on the board. Say each sound together: sh like 'shhh, be quiet', ch like a train going ch-ch, th with the tongue between the teeth.
Write ship, chin, thin and frog. Underline sh, ch and th. The children read each word.
Say 'ship' slowly. The children say its sounds: sh - i - p. Then they write it on their slates.
Look, cover, write: show 'milk' for five seconds, cover it, and the children write it. Check together. Repeat with tent, fish and drum.
activities.blackboard_hi:
sh ship    ch chin    th thin
milk   tent   fish   drum

reassessment.ask_hi: Read this word: chin. Then write the word 'fish'.

activities.materials_hi: Board or textbook page with 4 short lines
steps_hi: Write 4 short sentences on the board. Read the first one smoothly, like talking.
Echo reading: you read one line, the children read the same line back at the same speed.
In pairs, one child reads and the other points to each word and says 'wait' if a word is missed. Then they swap.
Read all the lines again as one little passage, pausing at each full stop. Ask: What is it about?
activities.blackboard_hi:
Raju has a bicycle.
He rides to the market.
He buys six mangoes.
He goes home.

reassessment.ask_hi: Read the four lines one after another without stopping at every word.
reassessment.expected: (child reads aloud smoothly, at most 1 mistake)

activities.materials_hi: A short story of 4–6 lines (from the textbook or written on the board); chalk
steps_hi: Read the story aloud twice. The second time, the children listen for names and places.
Ask: Who is in the story? What did he or she do? Where? If a child is not sure, read the line again and let the child find the answer in the text.
Write 4 key words on the board in story order, for example kite, roof, wind, laugh. The children say what happened for each word.
In pairs, one child tells the story back using the 4 words and the other helps. Then ask: What happened first? What happened last?
activities.blackboard_hi:
Who?   What?   Where?
first - next - last

reassessment.ask_hi: After a 3-line story, ask: Who is in the story? What did he or she do first?
reassessment.expected: An answer taken from the story

activities.materials_hi: Things in the room (book, pen, bag); a few children to act
steps_hi: Hold up a book: 'book' is a naming word. Ask a child to jump: 'jump' is a doing word. Point to a big bag: 'big' is a describing word.
Say pen, run, red, boy, sing, tall. The children show 1 finger for a naming word, 2 for a doing word, 3 for a describing word.
Draw three columns on the board: naming, doing, describing. Children come up and write one word in each column.
Give three words, for example girl, big, run. Ask for one sentence with all three: The big girl runs. Children say theirs aloud; write two on the board.
Check each sentence together: Is it a full sentence? Does it have a doing word?
activities.blackboard_hi:
Naming: book, girl
Doing: run, sing
Describing: big, red

reassessment.ask_hi: Which is a doing word: book, run or red? Now make a sentence with 'run'.
reassessment.expected: run; for example: The boy can run.
